title: Modeling Uncertainty and Using Post-fusion as Fallback Improves Retrieval Augmented Generation with LLMs
authors: Ye Liu; Semih Yavuz; Rui Meng; Meghana Moorthy; Shafiq Joty; Caiming Xiong; Yingbo Zhou
why_relevant: Studies how LLMs fail to use retrieved passages even when correct evidence is present, modeling 'unknown' outputs as uncertainty and proposing fallback fusion strategies. Directly addresses calibration/abstention and noisy-retrieval integration in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on single-hop QA with limited adversarial/conflict scope.
